_note: South America unresearched-seam round, Uruguay tier. 21 edges across 19 of 25 previously-unlinked UY nodes (uy-carne needed a new node, uy-reservas targets an existing corpus standard id imf-bpm6 rather than the agent's proposed new node); 4 remain dropped (no-document/unreadable-source). One new node minted: uy-inac (Instituto Nacional de Carnes), MGAP's own OPYPA yearbook names it directly as the source of cattle-slaughter and beef-export figures. ine.gub.uy and bcu.gub.uy were unreachable via direct fetch in this environment (TLS/network failures); worked around via a public reader-proxy and direct PDF downloads from bps.gub.uy, inale.org, gub.uy and mgap.gub.uy, all independently re-verified.

_dropped.why: Checked INE's institutional/census pages; as Uruguay's foundational primary data collection, no document was found stating it depends on another report.

BCU's Metodología y Clasificaciones and Cambio de Año Base pages reference INE's CLAEU classification and a Nota Metodológica file only by title, in a JS-driven document table with no resolvable download link/full text to quote from.

deuda.mef.gub.uy's Reportes Trimestrales/Reportes de Deuda Soberana/Datos pages and BCU's Finanzas Públicas page list report types but the actual quarterly PDFs weren't resolvable, and no page stated a specific sourcing dependency in accessible text.

The EAAE 2024 technical bulletin's methodology section is a self-contained INE enterprise survey with no stated external dependency — it is, in fact, an upstream source for uy-ivfim (see edge above), confirming the dependency runs the other direction.

Its only real, stated data source is the Encuesta Continua de Hogares, which is its own part_of container (uy-ech), making that edge invalid. No other external dependency found in INE's employment bulletins.
